ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a phase diagram with pressure on the vertical axis and temperature on the horizontal axis. The three phase boundary lines converge at an intersection slightly left of center, which can be regarded as the triple point: one curve goes from the lower left to the triple point and is the sublimation line; one relatively steep slanted line extends from the triple point toward the upper left and is the solid-liquid phase boundary line; another curve extends from the triple point toward the upper right and is the liquid-gas phase boundary line. Among the marked points, B is located to the left of the solid-liquid line and above the sublimation line; A is near/on the sublimation line at low temperature and low pressure; C is located to the upper right of the triple point and above the liquid-gas line; D is near the liquid-gas phase boundary line on the right side; E is located below the liquid-gas line. Reasoning: Judging according to the regions of the phase diagram, the region where the solid phase exists alone is the region to the left of the solid-liquid line and above the sublimation line. B is not on a phase boundary line, but is within this solid-phase region, so the corresponding substance is only the solid phase at equilibrium.

raw_record.question_text: In the phase diagram shown, which labeled point corresponds to the substance being solely in the solid phase at equilibrium? Answer with the point label only.

method.method_draft: Describe the image layout and locate the phase boundaries. Treat the meeting point as the triple point. Identify the solid region as the region left of the fusion/solid-liquid line and above the sublimation line. Check the labeled points and select the one inside that solid-only region rather than on a boundary; this gives B.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是压力纵轴、温度横轴的相图。三条相界线在中间偏左的一个交点汇合，可视为三相点：一条曲线从左下方到三相点，是升华线；一条较陡的斜线从三相点向左上方延伸，是固液相界线；另一条曲线从三相点向右上方延伸，是液气相界线。标记点中，B 位于固液线的左侧且在升华线之上；A 靠近/在低温低压的升华线附近；C 位于三相点右上、液气线之上；D 在右侧液气相界线附近；E 位于液气线下方。推理：按相图区域判断，固相单独存在的区域是固液线左侧并且升华线以上的区域。B 不在相界线上，而是在这个固相区域内，因此对应物质在平衡时仅为固相。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：该图是压力-温度相图，纵轴为 Pressure (atm)，横轴为 Temperature (°C)。图中有三条相界线在一个交点附近汇合：一条从左下向交点上升的曲线，一条从交点向右上延伸的曲线，以及一条从交点向左上延伸的较陡边界。点 A 位于左下方的相界线上，点 D 位于右上方相界线上，点 C 位于交点右侧且压力较高的区域内，点 E 位于右侧低压力区域内，点 B 位于低温、较高压力的左侧区域内且不在边界线上。推理：相界线上的点表示两相平衡，因此 A 和 D 不能表示单一固相。右侧低压力区域对应气相，因此 E 不是固相。中央偏右且较高压力区域对应液相，因此 C 不是固相。剩下的低温、较高压力且远离边界的点 B 位于固相区域，表示该物质仅为固相。
